import sys,pathlib,json,subprocess,concurrent.futures,datetime,time,shlex,hashlib,io,tarfile,re,shutil
BASE=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent

WORKSPACE=BASE.parents[3]
ROOT='/opt/vectormatch'; RELEASE=None
BUILD_TOOLS=None
OUT=WORKSPACE/'evidence/2026-10-23/runpod-optimization/nak'
PROFILE='extended-350k-256'

EVIDENCE=WORKSPACE/'evidence/2026-10-23/runpod-optimization'

PINNED_PROBE='29eaef020c644e9f64384c0b1773a5b4ede25326552b2cf6c68bf61799ebaf50'
PRIOR_PREPARED_SHA='2247db9c15b0043a0b28172c5bfa2d9e4f20b5748f6a16424d881e296102655f'
CONTROLLERS=('campaign.py','deploy-node.py','register.py','matrix.py','build.py','bundle-node.py')


def digest(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with pathlib.Path(path).open('rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()


def read_json(path):return json.loads(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())


def exclusive_save(path,value):
 path=pathlib.Path(path);path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')


def archive_manifest(release):
 assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}',release['revision'])
 assert pathlib.PurePosixPath(release['root']).name==release['revision']
 archive=pathlib.Path(release['archive']);assert archive.is_file() and not archive.is_symlink()
 assert archive.stat().st_size==release['archiveBytes'] and digest(archive)==release['bundleSha256']
 with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
  members=tar.getmembers();assert len(members)<=128
  assert len({m.name for m in members})==len(members)
  for item in members:
   q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(item.name)
   assert not q.is_absolute() and '..' not in q.parts and (item.isfile() or item.isdir())
  manifest=json.load(tar.extractfile('DEPLOYMENT.json'));assert manifest['revision']==release['revision']
  for name,expected in manifest['files'].items():
   assert hashlib.sha256(tar.extractfile(name).read()).hexdigest()==expected,name
  assert {m.name for m in members if m.isfile()}==set(manifest['files'])|{'DEPLOYMENT.json'}
 return manifest



def artifact_inputs(require_upload=False):
 """Validate local immutable new NAK inputs; never contact the cloud on import."""
 root=EVIDENCE/'nak';node=read_json(BASE/'node-release.json');build=read_json(BASE/'build.json')
 assert build['revision']==node['revision'] and build['source']=='git archive of committed source/build/tool files only'
 build_root=pathlib.Path(build['root']).resolve()
 assert build_root.parent==BASE and build_root.name=='build-'+node['revision']
 assert build.get('sourceArchiveSha256') and build.get('sourceRevisionExplicitlyPinned') is True
 manifest=archive_manifest(node);assert read_json(root/'node-deployment-manifest.json')==manifest
 assert manifest['revision']==build['revision'] and manifest['comparedAgainstNodeRevision']=='52fbf7fa46ed274891a2bbf0d9fba9d87456d1f5'
 java=read_json(root/'tool-validation/java-tests.json')
 assert java['revision']==node['revision'] and java['exitCode']==0 and java['failures']==0 and java['skipped']==0 and java['tests']>0
 tools={}
 for name in ('scripts/check-capacity-leader.py','scripts/verify-capacity-config.py','scripts/analyze-capacity.py','scripts/archive-capacity-arrivals.py'):
  path=build_root/name;assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink();tools[name]={'path':str(path),'sha256':digest(path)}
 observer=read_json(BASE.parent/'attribution-release.json');assert observer['identity']==PINNED_OBSERVER
 deployed=read_json(EVIDENCE/'attribution-deployment.json')
 assert deployed['identity']==observer['identity'] and deployed['sha256']==observer['sha256']
 assert {n['node'] for n in deployed['nodes'] if n['passed']}=={0,1,2}
 probe=read_json(BASE.parent/'network/socket-probe.json');assert probe['sha256']==PINNED_PROBE
 source=pathlib.Path(probe['source']);source=source if source.is_absolute() else WORKSPACE/source;assert digest(source)==PINNED_PROBE
 uploaded=read_json(EVIDENCE/'network/socket-probe-upload-receipt.json')
 assert {n['node'] for n in uploaded['nodes'] if n['verified'] and n['sha256']==PINNED_PROBE}=={0,1,2}
 if require_upload:
  upload=read_json(root/'node-upload-receipt.json');assert upload['bundleSha256']==node['bundleSha256'] and len(upload['nodes'])==3
  assert {n['node'] for n in upload['nodes']}=={0,1,2}
  for n in upload['nodes']:
   assert n['verified'] and n['nodeRevision']==node['revision'] and n['files']==manifest['files'] and n['launcherTest']['exitCode']==0
 return {'node':node,'load':dict(node),'observer':observer,'probe':probe,'build':build,'buildTools':tools}



def validate_identity(plan):
 identity=artifact_inputs(require_upload=True)
 for name in ('node','load','observer','probe','build','buildTools'):
  assert identity[name]==plan[name],'Artifact or verification tool changed: '+name
 assert set(plan['controllerSha256'])==set(CONTROLLERS)
 for name,expected in plan['controllerSha256'].items():assert digest(BASE/name)==expected,'Controller changed: '+name
 assert prerequisites()==plan['prerequisites'],'Frozen prerequisite evidence changed'
 pilot=plan.get('pilotPrerequisite')
 if pilot is not None:
  root=EVIDENCE/'nak';assert digest(root/'pilot-plan.json')==pilot['planSha256']
  task={'id':'k-pilot-100000ns-10000-w256','cohort':'pilot100us','rate':10000,'arrivals':350000,'workers':256,'nakDelayNs':100000,'phase':'nak-delay-full350k-canonical-pilot','repetition':1}
  assert checked_trial(root,task,identity,plan['preparedSnapshotSha256'])==pilot['trial'],'Pilot evidence changed'
 assert plan['noHiddenReissue'] is True and plan['requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial'] is True
 return identity



def configure(identity,delay_ns):
 global RELEASE,LOAD_RELEASE,BUILD_TOOLS,ATTRIBUTION_ROOT,SOCKET_PROBE,LOAD_IDENTITY,LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS
 assert delay_ns in (1000,100000)
 RELEASE=identity['node']['root'];LOAD_RELEASE=identity['load']['root'];BUILD_TOOLS=identity['buildTools'];assert RELEASE==LOAD_RELEASE
 COMMON.update({'VECTOR_DIST_ROOT':RELEASE+'/dist','VECTOR_MAX_CLUSTER_SESSIONS':'256',
  'VECTOR_MAX_HEAP':'2g','VECTOR_OUTBOX_CAPACITY':'800000','VECTOR_STATE_PROFILE':'capacity-350k-v1',
  'VECTOR_SOCKET_RECEIVE_BUFFER_BYTES':'131072','VECTOR_DRIVER_THREADING_MODE':'SHARED','VECTOR_NAK_UNICAST_DELAY_NS':str(delay_ns)})
 LOAD_JVM_ARGUMENTS=['-Dvectormatch.capacity.client.driver=shared','-Daeron.nak.unicast.delay='+str(delay_ns)]
 ATTRIBUTION_ROOT=identity['observer']['root'];SOCKET_PROBE=identity['probe']
 LOAD_IDENTITY={'loadGeneratorRevision':identity['load']['revision'],'loadGeneratorBundleSha256':identity['load']['bundleSha256'],
  'loadGeneratorRelease':LOAD_RELEASE,'attributionObserverIdentity':identity['observer']['identity'],'effectiveBufferProbeSha256':identity['probe']['sha256']}



def campaign_configuration(identity,prior,delay_ns,prepared_sha):
 assert delay_ns in (1000,100000) and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',prepared_sha)
 source=read_json(EVIDENCE/'window350k/w256/campaign.json')
 fixed={**source['fixed'],'nakUnicastDelayNs':delay_ns,'clientNakUnicastDelayNs':delay_ns,'nakUnicastRetryDelayRatio':100}
 return {**source,'registeredAtUtc':now(),'fixed':fixed,'screeningRates':[26000],'screeningWorkers':256,'concurrencySweep':[256],
  'preparedSnapshotSha256':prepared_sha,'sourceCampaign':str(EVIDENCE/'window350k/w256/campaign.json'),'prerequisites':prior,
  'scope':'Finite 350k/W256/26k/Q64 NAK delay comparison, node AND shared client driver1000ns vs100000ns, retry ratio100 unchanged. Same artifact/profile/maxSessions256/fixture/2g/sync2/SHARED/receive131072. All failed/invalid trials retained. Reported confirmations on canonical-incomplete runs are not correctness-validated throughput and cannot establish capacity. No full replicated checkpoint/restart claim.',
  'archivePolicy':{**source['archivePolicy'],'archiveToolSha256':identity['buildTools']['scripts/archive-capacity-arrivals.py']['sha256']}}



def analyze_and_archive(task,identity):
 """Runs even after a failed trial. Archive all available rows before applying validity gates."""
 directory=OUT/'runs'/task['id'];tools=identity['buildTools'];checks={}
 for name,args in (
  ('configuration',['scripts/verify-capacity-config.py',str(OUT),'--include-failed-unknown']),
  ('analysis',['scripts/analyze-capacity.py','--runs-dir',str(OUT/'runs'),'--output-dir',str(OUT/'analysis')])):
  tool=tools[args[0]];assert digest(tool['path'])==tool['sha256']
  command=[sys.executable,'-B',tool['path'],*args[1:]]
  result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
  checks[name]={'exitCode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr}
 csv=directory/'arrivals.csv'
 if csv.exists():
  assert not csv.is_symlink() and csv.is_file()
  summary=read_json(OUT/'analysis/summary.json')
  rows=[row for row in summary['trials'] if row['id']==task['id']];assert len(rows)==1
  expected=rows[0]['inputSha256']['arrivals.csv'];assert digest(csv)==expected
  tool=tools['scripts/archive-capacity-arrivals.py'];assert digest(tool['path'])==tool['sha256']
  packed=directory/'arrivals.csv.gz';manifest=directory/'arrivals-archive.json'
  if packed.exists() or manifest.exists():
   assert packed.exists() and manifest.exists(),'Partial archive exists; inspect, never overwrite'
   command=[sys.executable,'-B',tool['path'],'restore',str(directory)]
  else:command=[sys.executable,'-B',tool['path'],'archive',str(directory),'--expected-sha256',expected]
  result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
  checks['archive']={'exitCode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr,
   'toolSha256':tool['sha256'],'analyzerInputSha256':expected}
  assert result.returncode==0,'Arrival archive failed; preserve raw and inspect this trial'
  assert digest(csv)==expected,'Raw CSV changed during archiving'
  checks['archive']['rawCsvRetained']=True
 else:checks['archive']={'status':'no-arrivals-csv-produced','rawEvidencePreserved':True}
 exclusive_save(directory/'postprocess.json',checks)
 assert checks['configuration']['exitCode']==0 and checks['analysis']['exitCode']==0,'Validation failed; raw archive retained'
 return checks


def checked_trial(root,task,identity,prepared_sha=None):
 directory=root/task['cohort']/'runs'/task['id'];trial=read_json(directory/'trial.json');receipt=read_json(directory/'receipt.json')
 assert trial.get('completedAt') and read_json(directory/'all-owned-processes-stopped.json')['passed']
 assert read_json(directory/'fixed-leader-check.json')['passed'] and read_json(directory/'configuration-verification.json')['passed']
 assert trial['release']==identity['node']['root'] and trial['deploymentBundleSha256']==identity['node']['bundleSha256']
 for key in ('rate','arrivals','workers','phase','repetition'):assert trial[key]==task[key],key
 configuration=read_json(directory/'configuration.json');load=read_json(directory/'load-result.json')
 assert configuration['preparedSnapshotSha256']==prepared_sha and digest(directory/'prepared-snapshot.bin')==prepared_sha
 assert configuration['profile']=='extended-350k-256' and configuration['expectedStateProfile']=='capacity-350k-v1'
 assert configuration['workers']==256 and configuration['queueCapacityPerWorker']==64
 assert configuration['scheduledArrivals']==350000 and configuration['ratePerSecond']==task['rate']
 assert configuration['seededMakerQuantity']==380000 and configuration['seededQuotePerBuyer']==1900000000
 assert configuration['initialResultCachePerProducer']==1024 and configuration['validationTimeoutSeconds']==600
 assert configuration['clientDriverMode']=='shared' and configuration['clientDriverCount']==1
 assert configuration['clientAeronMode']=='one-independent-Aeron-per-client'
 assert configuration['clientNakUnicastDelayNs']==task['nakDelayNs'] and configuration['clientNakUnicastRetryDelayRatio']==100
 fixed=trial['fixedNodeConfiguration'];assert fixed['maxClusterSessions']==256 and fixed['outboxCapacity']==800000 and fixed['maxRetainedOrders']==360000
 assert fixed['driverThreadingArgument']=='SHARED' and fixed['socketReceiveBufferArgumentBytes']==131072
 assert fixed['nakUnicastDelayNs']==fixed['clientNakUnicastDelayNs']==task['nakDelayNs'] and fixed['nakUnicastRetryDelayRatio']==100
 summary=read_json(root/task['cohort']/'analysis/summary.json');rows=[x for x in summary['trials'] if x['id']==task['id']];assert len(rows)==1;row=rows[0]
 for name,expected in row['inputSha256'].items():assert pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).name==name and digest(directory/name)==expected,name
 archive=read_json(directory/'arrivals-archive.json')
 assert archive['rawSha256']==row['inputSha256']['arrivals.csv'] and archive['compressedSha256']==digest(directory/'arrivals.csv.gz')
 assert read_json(directory/'postprocess.json')['archive']['exitCode']==0
 result_path=directory/'result.json';canonical=False;guarded=False
 if result_path.exists():
  result=read_json(result_path);assert receipt['exitCode']==0 and result['passed'] and result['canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified'];canonical=True
 else:
  failure=read_json(directory/'failure.json');guarded=expected_unknown_failure(failure,load)
  assert receipt['exitCode']!=0 and guarded,'Unexpected failure: halt after retaining raw; do not continue matrix'
 return {'id':task['id'],'classification':row['classification'],'measurementValid':row.get('measurementValid'),
  'canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified':canonical,'expectedCanonicalIncompleteUnknownGuard':guarded,
  'capacityEligible':canonical and row.get('measurementValid') is True,
  'preparedSnapshotSha256':prepared_sha,'summarySha256':digest(root/task['cohort']/'analysis/summary.json'),
  'reportedArrivalWindowConfirmations':load.get('confirmedWithinArrivalWindow'),
  'reportedArrivalWindowConfirmationsPerSecond':load.get('confirmedWithinArrivalWindowPerSecond'),
  'reportedCountsScope':'Client-reported only on canonical-incomplete failure; never capacity or validated business success.',
  'unknownAtInitialDeadline':load.get('unknownAtInitialDeadline'),'unresolvedFinal':load.get('unresolvedFinal'),
  'archiveManifestSha256':digest(directory/'arrivals-archive.json')}



def run_task(root,task,plan,identity,prepared_sha=None):
 global OUT
 validate_identity(plan);configure(identity,task['nakDelayNs']);OUT=root/task['cohort'];directory=OUT/'runs'/task['id']
 if directory.exists():
  row=checked_trial(root,task,identity,prepared_sha);print('NAK_EXISTING_COMPLETED_TRIAL_NOT_REPLAYED',json.dumps(row),flush=True);return row
 budget(600);error=None
 try:trial(task['id'],task['rate'],task['arrivals'],task['workers'],task['phase'],task['repetition'])
 except BaseException as failure:error=failure
 if directory.exists():
  # Every path attempts identity-checked stop before archive or a fresh trial. A mismatch fails closed.
  cleanup_error=None;stopped=None
  try:stopped=stop_all_owned(directory)
  except BaseException as failure:
   cleanup_error=failure
   exclusive_save(directory/'owned-cleanup-failure.json',{'timestamp':now(),'errorType':type(failure).__name__,'error':str(failure),'passed':False,'nextTrialPermitted':False})
  if not (directory/'trial.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Missing trial manifest; inspect without replay')
  if not read_json(directory/'trial.json').get('completedAt'):
   try:finish(task['id'])
   except BaseException as failure:
    exclusive_save(directory/'export-or-finalize-failure.json',{'timestamp':now(),'errorType':type(failure).__name__,'error':str(failure),'nextTrialPermitted':False})
    if cleanup_error is None:cleanup_error=failure
  try:analyze_and_archive(task,identity)
  except BaseException:
   raise RuntimeError('Postprocess failed; available raw retained, no fresh trial permitted') from error
  if cleanup_error is not None:raise RuntimeError('Owned cleanup/export failed; archived available raw, matrix halted') from cleanup_error
  assert stopped['passed'],'Owned process still running/identity mismatch; matrix must halt'
  row=checked_trial(root,task,identity,prepared_sha)
  if error is not None and not row['expectedCanonicalIncompleteUnknownGuard']:raise error
  print('NAK_TRIAL_RETAINED_RESULT',json.dumps(row),flush=True);return row
 if error is not None:raise error
 raise RuntimeError('Trial never produced evidence; do not resubmit this ID automatically')



def prerequisites():
 paths={'pilotReport':EVIDENCE/'window350k/analysis/pilot-attribution-summary.json',
  'failedWindowReport':EVIDENCE/'window350k/analysis/failed-window-attribution-summary.json',
  'priorFormalPlan':EVIDENCE/'window350k/plan.json',
  'pilotResult':EVIDENCE/'window350k/pilot/runs/w-pilot-10000-w128/result.json',
  'pilotConfiguration':EVIDENCE/'window350k/pilot/runs/w-pilot-10000-w128/configuration.json'}
 assert digest(paths['failedWindowReport'])=='9656ad7bf230ebefebbd92829bdc531f8940fdba570e9ede585c06b06555ef90'
 result=read_json(paths['pilotResult']);assert result['passed'] and result['canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified']
 prepared=read_json(paths['pilotConfiguration'])['preparedSnapshotSha256'];assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',prepared)
 return {'inputs':{name:{'path':str(p),'sha256':digest(p)} for name,p in paths.items()},'preparedSnapshotSha256':prepared,
  'scope':'Historical pilot validated full350k canonical core snapshot/outbox/assets only, not replicated checkpoint/restart. Prior W256 attempt failed and original matrix halted after two trials; no prior four-point completion prerequisite.'}






def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def save(path,obj):path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2)+'\n')
def record(action,**kw):
 row={'timestamp':now(),'action':action,**kw};print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 with (OUT/'timeline.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
def budget(seconds=600):
 dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);cost=sum((dt-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(n['created_utc_estimate'].replace('Z','+00:00'))).total_seconds()/3600*(n['hourly_compute_usd']+n['hourly_disk_usd_estimate']) for n in remote.NODES)
 d={'asOfUtc':now(),'estimatedAccruedUsd':cost,'nextTrialReserveSeconds':seconds,'projectedIncludingRecoveryReserveUsd':cost+1.56*seconds/3600+2,'budgetUsd':20,'scope':'Project three Pods only, launch-time/rate estimate, not reconciled bill'}
 assert d['projectedIncludingRecoveryReserveUsd']<20,d
 return d

def py(i,code,timeout=90):
 p=remote.run(i,'python3 -B -',input=code,timeout=timeout)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'node{i} rc{p.returncode}: {p.stdout} {p.stderr}')
 return p.stdout

def service(i,role,action,env):
 supervisor=RELEASE+'/deploy/remote_service.py'
 args=['python3','-B',supervisor,role,action]+([str(i)] if role=='node' else [])
 code='CONFIG='+repr({**env,'VECTOR_MAX_HEAP':env.get('VECTOR_MAX_HEAP','1g') if role=='node' else '512m'})+'\nARGS='+repr(args)+'\n'+'''import os,subprocess
e=os.environ.copy();e.update(CONFIG);p=subprocess.run(ARGS,cwd='/opt/vectormatch',env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45);print(p.stdout+p.stderr);raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
'''
 return py(i,code,60)

def parallel(fn):
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as pool:return list(pool.map(fn,range(3)))

def members(state):
 args=[JAVA,*OPENS,'-Xmx128m','-cp',RELEASE+'/dist/cluster/lib/*','io.aeron.cluster.ClusterTool',state+'/node-0/cluster','list-members']
 p=remote.run(0,' '.join(map(shlex.quote,args)),timeout=25)
 return {'timestamp':now(),'exitCode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}

SPAWN='''import os,pathlib,subprocess,json,hashlib,time,importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('svc',RELEASE+'/deploy/remote_service.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
base=pathlib.Path(WATCH);base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
e=os.environ.copy();e.update(ENV)
records={}
for name,args in JOBS.items():
 record=base/(name+'-process.json')
 if record.exists():raise RuntimeError('Refusing duplicate job '+name)
 with (base/(name+'.log')).open('ab') as log:
  child=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd='/opt/vectormatch',env=e,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)

 result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(Guards));return 0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1


if __name__=='__main__':
 if sys.argv[1:]==['--self-test']:raise SystemExit(self_test())
 raise SystemExit('Prepare-only helper: root must explicitly review, register.py --write, then matrix.py --execute. No auto launch.')

"""Upload/check a new immutable release and run launcher tests; never start nodes."""
import json
import shlex
import campaign as c


REMOTE_VERIFY = '''import pathlib,hashlib,tarfile,json,subprocess,sys
base=pathlib.Path(RELEASE)
manifest=base/'DEPLOYMENT.json'
if not manifest.exists():
 assert {p.name for p in base.iterdir()} <= {'bundle.tar.gz.part'}
 part=base/'bundle.tar.gz.part';assert hashlib.sha256(part.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED
 with tarfile.open(part) as archive:
  for member in archive.getmembers():
   q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name)
   assert not q.is_absolute() and '..' not in q.parts and (member.isfile() or member.isdir())
  archive.extractall(base)
 part.replace(base/'bundle.tar.gz')
assert hashlib.sha256((base/'bundle.tar.gz').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED
d=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert d==MANIFEST
for name,digest in d['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((base/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(base/'deploy'),'-p','test_remote_service.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
print(json.dumps({'verified':p.returncode==0,'nodeRevision':d['revision'],'files':d['files'],'launcherTest':{'exitCode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}}))
raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
'''


def main():
    import argparse
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--execute',action='store_true');options=parser.parse_args()
    assert options.execute, 'Deployment is separate: root must explicitly pass --execute after review'
    identity = c.artifact_inputs(require_upload=False)
    node = identity['node']
    target = c.EVIDENCE / 'nak/node-upload-receipt.json'
    assert not target.exists(), 'Upload receipt exists; validate/resume it explicitly, never overwrite'
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(node)

    def one(member):
        # Upload only to the separate commit-named immutable release directory.
        release = node['root']
        assert release.startswith('/opt/vectormatch/optimization-node-releases/')
        result = c.remote.run(member, 'mkdir -p ' + shlex.quote(release))
        assert result.returncode == 0
        inspect = ('import pathlib,json\np=pathlib.Path(' + repr(release) + ')\n'
                   'print(json.dumps({"manifestPresent":(p/"DEPLOYMENT.json").exists()}))')
        existing = json.loads(c.py(member, inspect, 20))
        if not existing['manifestPresent']:
            transfer = c.remote.upload(member, node['archive'], release + '/bundle.tar.gz.part')
            assert transfer.returncode == 0, 'Node bundle transfer failed'
        code = ('RELEASE=' + repr(release) + '\nEXPECTED=' + repr(node['bundleSha256'])
                + '\nMANIFEST=' + repr(manifest) + '\n' + REMOTE_VERIFY)
        receipt = json.loads(c.py(member, code, 65))
        receipt['node'] = member
        return receipt

    rows = c.parallel(one)
    assert len(rows) == 3 and all(row['verified'] for row in rows)
    c.exclusive_save(target, {'timestamp': c.now(), 'bundleSha256': node['bundleSha256'],
                            'nodes': rows, 'scope': 'Immutable new release transfer/hash and Linux launcher unit tests only; no node, load, original service or kernel setting is started/stopped/changed.'})
    print('NAK_NODE_UPLOAD_VERIFIED', node['revision'], flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Execute only an immutable explicitly registered plan; importing submits nothing."""
import argparse
import campaign as c
import register


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=('pilot', 'matrix'), default='matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
    options = parser.parse_args()
    assert options.execute, 'Root must review and explicitly --execute; default submits no work'
    root = c.EVIDENCE / 'nak'
    name = 'pilot-plan.json' if options.kind == 'pilot' else 'plan.json'
    plan = c.read_json(root / name)
    identity = c.validate_identity(plan)
    assert plan['trials'] == register.tasks(options.kind), 'Task order/IDs/factor changed'
    assert plan['loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds'] == plan['validationTimeoutSeconds'] == 600
    prepared = plan['preparedSnapshotSha256']
    assert prepared == plan['prerequisites']['preparedSnapshotSha256']
    prior_stopped = c.verify_historical_owned_stopped(identity)
    gate_path = root / ('pilot-historical-owned-stopped.json' if options.kind == 'pilot' else 'matrix-historical-owned-stopped.json')
    if gate_path.exists():
        assert c.read_json(gate_path)['passed']
    else:
        c.exclusive_save(gate_path, prior_stopped)
    results = []
    for task in plan['trials']:
        assert (task['workers'], task['arrivals']) == (256, 350000)
        assert task['nakDelayNs'] in (1000, 100000)
        if results:
            previous = root / plan['trials'][len(results) - 1]['cohort'] / 'runs' / results[-1]['id']
            assert c.read_json(previous / 'all-owned-processes-stopped.json')['passed']
            assert c.stop_all_owned(previous)['passed'], 'Fresh live identity check required before next trial'
        results.append(c.run_task(root, task, plan, identity, prepared))
    c.OUT = root
    c.record('nak-delay-' + options.kind + '-completed', trials=results, budget=c.budget(0),
             scope='Completed means all registered attempts retained and owned processes stopped. Canonical-incomplete attempts remain failures; no capacity assertion.')
    print('NAK_PLAN_COMPLETE_INSPECT_BEFORE_NEXT_FACTOR', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Draft by default. Root must review and explicitly --write; no load is submitted."""
import argparse
import json
import campaign as c


def tasks(kind):
    if kind == 'pilot':
        return [{'id': 'k-pilot-100000ns-10000-w256', 'cohort': 'pilot100us',
                 'rate': 10000, 'arrivals': 350000, 'workers': 256, 'nakDelayNs': 100000,
                 'phase': 'nak-delay-full350k-canonical-pilot', 'repetition': 1}]
    return [{'id': f'k-nak{delay}-26000-w256-r{rep}',
             'cohort': f'delay{delay}', 'rate': 26000, 'arrivals': 350000,
             'workers': 256, 'nakDelayNs': delay,
             'phase': 'nak-delay-node-and-client-control', 'repetition': rep}
            for rep in (1, 2) for delay in (1000, 100000)]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=('pilot', 'matrix'), default='matrix')
    parser.add_argument('--pilot-policy', choices=('require-b350k', 'skip-reviewed'))
    parser.add_argument('--write', action='store_true')
    options = parser.parse_args()
    root = c.EVIDENCE / 'nak'
    # Draft paths are intentionally not touched. Build/deployment is a separate root action.
    if not options.write:
        print(json.dumps({'draftOnly': True, 'noRegistrationOrLaunch': True,
                          'kind': options.kind, 'trials': tasks(options.kind),
                          'writeRequires': ['new committed source-pinned build and 3-node immutable upload',
                                            'explicit root-selected pilot policy',
                                            'budget including 2 USD recovery reserve',
                                            'unchanged historical prerequisite SHA inputs']}, indent=2))
        return
    assert options.pilot_policy is not None, 'Root must explicitly select pilot policy before registration'
    identity = c.artifact_inputs(require_upload=True)
    prior = c.prerequisites()
    prepared = prior['preparedSnapshotSha256']
    name = 'pilot-plan.json' if options.kind == 'pilot' else 'plan.json'
    assert not (root / name).exists(), 'Plan exists; inspect/resume exact IDs, never overwrite'
    trial_rows = tasks(options.kind)
    pilot = None
    if options.kind == 'matrix' and options.pilot_policy == 'require-b350k':
        pilot_plan = c.read_json(root / 'pilot-plan.json')
        pilot_identity = c.validate_identity(pilot_plan)
        assert pilot_identity == identity
        pilot = c.checked_trial(root, tasks('pilot')[0], identity, prepared)
        assert pilot['canonicalSnapshotBytesVerified'] and pilot['measurementValid'], 'Full B pilot must pass canonical correctness and timing'
        pilot = {'planSha256': c.digest(root / 'pilot-plan.json'), 'trial': pilot}
    for task in trial_rows:
        assert not (root / task['cohort'] / 'runs' / task['id']).exists(), 'Existing ID; never replay'
        assert not (root / task['cohort'] / 'campaign.json').exists(), 'Partial registration; inspect, never overwrite'
    projected = c.budget(900 if options.kind == 'pilot' else 3000)
    manifest = c.archive_manifest(identity['node'])
    for task in trial_rows:
        cohort = root / task['cohort']
        if (cohort / 'campaign.json').exists():
            continue
        campaign = c.campaign_configuration(identity, prior, task['nakDelayNs'], prepared)
        if options.kind == 'pilot':
            campaign.update({'screeningRates': [10000], 'scope': campaign['scope'] + ' Optional W256/B 35-second full350k canonical pilot before matrix.'})
        c.exclusive_save(cohort / 'campaign.json', campaign)
        c.exclusive_save(cohort / 'deployment.json', identity['node'])
        c.exclusive_save(cohort / 'deployment-manifest.json', manifest)
    c.exclusive_save(root / name, {'registeredAtUtc': c.now(), **identity,
        'prerequisites': prior, 'pilotPolicy': options.pilot_policy, 'pilotPrerequisite': pilot,
        'controllerSha256': {name: c.digest(c.BASE / name) for name in c.CONTROLLERS},
        'preparedSnapshotSha256': prepared, 'trials': trial_rows, 'budget': projected,
        'newResources': 0, 'localFreeBytesPerTrialMinimum': 1073741824,
        'loadWholeProcessTimeoutSeconds': 600, 'validationTimeoutSeconds': 600,
        'requireAllOwnedProcessesStoppedBeforeNextTrial': True, 'noHiddenReissue': True,
        'allowedFailureSignature': c.UNKNOWN_GUARD,
        'scope': 'Two NAK delays on node AND shared client driver, same new artifact and all other fixed configuration. Preserve each failed/invalid and gzip raw CSV before gates. Only exact canonical-incomplete UNKNOWN guard may continue after nonzero receipt; unexpected business mismatch/leader/config/resource cleanup failures halt. Client reported confirmations on failure are never capacity.'})
    print('NAK_REGISTERED_NO_LOAD_SUBMITTED', options.kind, len(trial_rows), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
